name: Manner of issuing an invoice — copies, and electronic preparation
definition: Rule 48 fixes how an invoice is issued: three copies for goods, two for services, serial numbers reported in FORM GSTR-1, and, for notified classes of person, preparation through the common portal with an Invoice Reference Number. An invoice issued outside that last manner is not an invoice.
why_it_exists: It separates 'the invoice says the right things' from 'the invoice was issued the right way'. A document can satisfy every rule 46 particular and still not be an invoice, because of rule 48(5).
inputs: whether the supply is of goods or of services
whether the supplier belongs to a class notified under rule 48(4)
the copy markings on the document
outputs: the number and marking of copies required
whether rule 48(4) preparation was required and met
preconditions: an invoice is being issued under rule 46
exceptions: rule 48(6) switches off the triplicate and duplicate requirements for an invoice prepared under rule 48(4)
the Commissioner may exempt a person or class of registered persons from rule 48(4) by notification
common_mistakes: expecting a DUPLICATE FOR TRANSPORTER copy on a services invoice — services take two copies, not three
treating a rule 48(4) failure as a missing field — rule 48(5) says the document is not an invoice at all
assuming every registered person must obtain an Invoice Reference Number — it binds only notified classes
gst_references: UNKNOWN — source is the Rules as at 01-01-2022; later amendments not held locally
evidence_required: the copy marking on the document
whether the supplier is in a class notified under rule 48(4)
confidence_factors: weak when only one copy of a multi-copy document was photographed, which says nothing about whether the others exist
weak when the notified classes under rule 48(4) are unknown, because they are fixed by notification and no notification is held locally
validation_checks: a goods invoice bears one of ORIGINAL FOR RECIPIENT, DUPLICATE FOR TRANSPORTER or TRIPLICATE FOR SUPPLIER
a services invoice bears one of ORIGINAL FOR RECIPIENT or DUPLICATE FOR SUPPLIER
where rule 48(4) applies, the invoice carries the rule 46(r) Quick Response code with the Invoice Reference Number embedded
examples: a goods invoice marked ORIGINAL FOR RECIPIENT — consistent with rule 48(1)
counterexamples: a services invoice marked TRIPLICATE FOR SUPPLIER — rule 48(2) provides only two copies for services

Every invoice issued by a person to whom sub-rule (4) applies in any manner other than the manner specified in the said sub-rule shall not be treated as an invoice.

Provided that the Commissioner may, on the recommendations of the Council, by notification, exempt a person or a class of registered persons from issuance of invoice under this sub-rule for a specified period, subject to such conditions and restrictions as may be specified in the said notification.
